node.statement: F3 h=3 CHAR-0 CLASSIFICATION (2026-07-08, Codex overnight Terminal A, REPLAYED + VERIFIED; nodes/u1_x4_direct_column_budget/notes/F3_H3_CHAR0_CLASSIFICATION.md): any two DISTINCT 3-subsets of roots of unity with equal e1 and e2 are zero-sum mu_3 cosets (the toral column, C(n/3,2) pairs, existing iff 3 | n). Proof (three lines, no Conway-Jones): on the unit circle e2 = e3 * conj(e1); distinct sets sharing (e1, e2) differ in e3, so conj(e1) = 0; zero-sum unit triples have Re(u) = -1/2 after normalization = primitive cube roots. NORM-GATE COROLLARY: every non-toral shape has a nonzero obstruction E_i in Z[zeta_n] with |Norm| <= 6^phi(n), so each shape activates at <= floor(phi(n) log6 / (2 log n)) primes >= n^2 (per-shape bound; pair-coprimality per-row remains open). Machine-verified: exact cyclotomic enumeration through n = 96 (toral counts exact, zero exotics at all orders incl. 5, 7, 9 | n) + the three banked norm-gate shapes certified. The proof uses complex conjugation — no char-p analogue — EXPLAINING why interior families exist only as p-selected accidents. STRUCTURAL CONSEQUENCE: h=3 interior mass = norm-gate accidents with proved activation bounds; the F3-green path's h=3 gap narrows to pair-coprimality + the Poisson accident census.
